title: Implement Route Focus Management in Vue
description: Add page title update and focus management to a Vue Router app.
problemStatement:
## Vue Router Accessibility

You have a Vue 3 app with Vue Router. Currently, when navigating between pages, the document title does not update, and focus stays on the navigation link. Also, there's no skip link.

Implement the following:

1. In each route's meta, add a `title` field (e.g., `meta: { title: 'About' }`).
2. Use `router.afterEach` to set `document.title` based on `to.meta.title`.
3. In the main `App.vue`, add a `<div id='main-content' tabindex='-1'>` wrapper around `<router-view>`, and after each route change, focus that element. Use `watch` on the route and `nextTick`.
4. Add a skip link at the top of `App.vue` that links to `#main-content`.

Provide the necessary code snippets for `router/index.js` and `App.vue`.
expectedOutput: Working Vue Router setup with focus and title management.
